Lina (growth): quick heads-up 1am PT1 1 dashboard shows a +300 signup bump for launch landing but paid spend is flat. can someone pull hourly and click logs?
Owen (analytics): pulling Launch > Inbound routing > 48h. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/inbound-routing?range=48h
Owen (analytics): spike between 00:40-01:10 UTC, uniques +120, impressions +1.8x. sample clicks show 38 rows missing utm_medium.
Pri (ops): check ingest: NotifyBot: pipeline-ingest 2026-05-10T01:20Z completed; 38 anomalous rows flagged where utm_medium=null in partition 2026-05-10-00.
Cal (ads): we ran a small APAC push at 00:30 UTC (campaign=apac_q2_launch). creative should include utm_medium=cpc.
Lina (growth): sounds like attribution got stripped (likely webview/redirect). can we pause nurture for affected IDs to avoid duplicate outreach?
Pri (ops): will add CRM tag "hold-reclass" to 38 IDs and remove from tomorrow's nurture cohort. creating ticket MKT-7001 "inbound-routing utm_medium loss" assigned to eng-redirects.
Owen (analytics): will queue a rejoin job after infra fix: reproc-3961-01. ETA for updated pre/post CAC numbers for Friday KPI deck is 6 hours after reproc.
Cal (ads): mitigation: change landing redirect to server-side append on first hit; infra can flip a small rule today. filing INF-3102.
NotifyBot: follow-up scheduled: rejoin job queued post-INF-3102 deploy.
Lina (growth): please add a dashboard annotation and a one-line note in weekly KPI doc: "05/10 APAC attribution drift due to param loss; reclassification pending reproc."
Pri (ops): annotation added and KPI sheet flagged. will post reproc sample when ready.
Owen (analytics): shared sample: https://s3.redwood.com/exports/inbound-reproc-sample-3961.csv (10 rows). rough est: if all 38 reclass to paid, cohort CAC +10%. will confirm after full reproc.
Lina (growth): perfect. follow-ups: Pri  CRM hold + ticket; Cal  infra change; Owen  reproc and pre/post numbers. I'll call out in Friday KPI review. :white_check_mark:
